messages:
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT OPENED - metering: token_shadow_delta > 30% in eu-west and us-east. Severity P2. Paging #oncall-metering.

sasha: I'm on it, joining.

matt: seeing the same — shadow ledger shows +12k tokens/min vs prod. Overages triggered for subset of customers (4 flagged).

kevin: connecting to billing dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/metering/shadow-delta?ts=1717248000

sasha: logs show emitter retries around 17:19:10, suspect duplicate ack path. snippet:
```
2024-05-01T17:19:10Z emitter id=em-42 retry_count=3 status=OK tokens_emitted=120
2024-05-01T17:19:11Z ack missing for seq=98765
```

liz: customer-facing alerts already sent by alerting-runbook? CS says 3 customers got automated overage emails.

matt: recommend mute overage-notify job until we confirm. Who can run mute?

carla: I can mute for 30m. Doing: /runbook mute overage-notify --reason "shadow delta high"

pagerduty-bot: carla acknowledged the pager at 1717248123.

carla: muted. Also kicking off quick reconciliation to check true billable tokens: `/scripts/reconcile_tokens --since 1717240000 --fast` (will take ~8m)

kevin: rolling a hotfix patch to emitter dedupe logic to avoid duplicate counts in shadow path. Deploying to canary.

sasha: can you add temporary guard in metering pipeline to ignore duplicated seq numbers? Patch PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/pull/4821

matt: can we get estimate for customer impact? carla, CS on it?

carla: CS confirms 3 customers (acct 1123, 4456, 9900) received overage email. None opened support tickets yet. Suggest proactively notify them once we have root cause.

liz: agreed. We'll prepare a short note: "We've identified spurious overage alerts from metering; we're pausing notifications and reconciling usage. No billing adjustments have been applied yet."

matt: reconciliation finished: preliminary shows ~2.8k tokens overcount total, majority duplicates. Not actual usage spike.

kevin: canary looks good; dedupe applied, no extra emissions. Rolling to prod in next 4m.

sasha: prod patch complete. Metrics showing shadow delta normalizing to <2%.

carla: unmuting overage-notify in 30m unless further anomalies. Notifying CS to hold customer comms until confirmed.

matt: action items: (1) postmortem owner kevin, (2) patch to add stricter seq dedupe in emitter (#4821), (3) add alert to detect emitter-retry spikes. I'll file tickets.

kevin: filing now. ticket MET-7890, will include timeline and metrics.

sasha: closing thread when CS confirms customers notified with follow-up note.

liz: CS will notify customers with templated message and offer manual credit if they were billed after final reconciliation. Will update.

pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED - status: mitigated. Close reason: dedupe hotfix deployed and confirmations pending. Severity downgraded to P3 at 1717249185.
